paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 6.14 as of 2026-08-17, with a change of -4.06% from the prior close and 0.33% over a window of 21 sessions. There have been 2 new news articles in the last 24 hours.

Fermi Inc. has received recent news coverage due to a subpoena from the US District Court for the Eastern District of New York related to Project Matador, with articles from marketscreener.com and Seeking Alpha reporting on the development. The news has had an impact on the stock price, with shares falling after the announcement.

There have been recent SEC filings from Fermi Inc., including a 10-Q form reporting a net loss for the second quarter of 2026, as well as an 8-K form announcing the appointment of Lee McIntire as the new Chief Executive Officer, effective August 11, 2026, with an annualized base salary of $750,000. Additionally, there has been one Form 4 filing in the feed, and 12 proxy solicitation filings.
